profile_text.body:
Synthesia is an AI video platform for business, according to its own site. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in London. It describes its product as letting users create studio-quality videos with AI avatars and voiceovers in 140+ languages, without mics, cameras, actors, or studios. Features listed on the site include an AI avatar generator, PowerPoint to video, custom avatars, a free AI video generator, an AI video editor, AI voice cloning, AI screen recorder, text to video, script to video, roleplay sessions, and interactive avatars. Synthesia says its Basic plan is free with no credit card required and includes 500 credits a month, enough for up to 10 minutes of video or 10 minutes of AI Dubbing.

The site states that the platform is trusted by 90%+ of the Fortune 100 to communicate, train, and upskill teams in 140+ languages. It describes Interactive Avatars for two-way conversations, AI Dubbing that translates finished videos in the original speaker's voice, and an API for building the video technology into other products. Synthesia says it is SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and ISO 42001 certified, and GDPR compliant with EU data residency. It states that every video goes through content moderation and that no one's likeness becomes an avatar without their explicit consent. The site also notes that its content is generated using artificial intelligence and labeled in accordance with EU AI Act Article 50 requirements.

Synthesia is tracked as a product in the Video Generation & Editing category, with a note on AI avatars and likeness and consent risk. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
